title: CDI - CRM Manager Assurance (H/F) - Insurtech scale-up, Paris - CDI
description:
Salaire: 55 - 65 K€ brut annuel, dont 5 % de bonus.

Tu construis tes parcours CRM de bout en bout, tu débugges tes propres journeys et tu veux transformer chaque signal client en expérience ultra-personnalisée ? Cette annonce est pour toi.

IN DA HOUSE recrute, pour l'un de ses clients - scale-up française de l'assurance, pure player insurtech B2C multiproduits en forte croissance - un(e) CRM Manager Assurance en CDI pour renforcer son équipe CRM.

Le contexte

-       Un périmètre 100 % assurance, en binôme, au sein d'une équipe CRM de 5 personnes organisée par verticales métier.

-       Le coeur du jeu : des parcours post-souscription ultra-personnalisés. Après chaque souscription, relancer chaque client sur SES documents manquants: pièce d'identité, relevé d'information, carte grise provisoire ou définitive, conducteur secondaire...

-       Des enjeux business concrets: conversion devis / contrat, activation post-souscription, rétention et renouvellement, complétion de dossier, anti-churn et cross-sell sur une offre multiproduits.

-       Une stack qui donne envie : Braze, Segment, BigQuery, app mobile (push, in-app messages), RCS en exploration, Wallet dans les starting-blocks.

-       Une équipe déjà en avance sur l'IA : Claude et Claude Code au quotidien, un MCP connecté à Braze, Segment et BigQuery, des visuels et contenus générés par IA et alignés au tone of voice. Ici, l'IA transforme déjà la façon de travailler. Ce n'est pas un effet d'annonce.

 Une seule boussole, dans ce scope: une expérience client impeccable pour booster la conversion. Faire du CRM un contributeur majeur de la marge.

Concrètement, tu vas :

-       Concevoir, intégrer, recetter et débugger toi-même des journeys et triggers dans Braze, de l'idée à la mise en production.

-       Manipuler Liquid (ou son équivalent) pour construire des communications individualisées avec de la logique conditionnelle complexe : cas métier multiples, exclusions, priorités, cas limites.

-       Traduire un besoin CRM en attributs, événements et règles de gestion, et challenger la Data sur la qualité et la disponibilité de la donnée.

-       Piloter la performance : A/B tests adossés à une hypothèse et un KPI, identification des frictions, optimisations mesurables.

-       Sécuriser chaque scénario : recette systématique, obligations légales, arbitrages juridiques sur les sujets sensibles.

-       Déployer les campagnes d'animation commerciale de A à Z : ciblage, création des templates (wording et visuels), routage et gestion de la pression commerciale, suivi des performances, plan de tracking rigoureux et propre.

-       Travailler au quotidien avec Produit, Data, Legal, Support, Sales et Pricing. Weekly de priorisation, monthly de partage de savoir : on se parle, on progresse ensemble.

Le profil qu'on cherche :

-       5 à 8 ans d'expérience en CRM lifecycle ou marketing automation, sur des parcours longs et complexes (onboarding, post-souscription, rétention, renouvellement, cross-sell). Pas uniquement de la campagne one-shot.

-       Une autonomie technique réelle dans un outil CRM, idéalement Braze. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign ou Iterable conviennent si tu as réellement construit et intégré les parcours toi-même.

-       Tu conçois, tu intègres, tu testes, tu débugges. Tu n'attends pas qu'une équipe Tech  reprenne ton sujet.

-       Tu manipules Liquid ou un langage équivalent (AMPscript...) bien au-delà du prénom dans l'objet : conditions, blocs dynamiques, cas clients multiples.

-       Mindset Data : tu penses en attributs et événements, tu lis les perfs dans un dashboard, tu poses un dispositif de mesure, tu arbitres.

-       Fibre business obligatoire.

-       Un usage professionnel et concret de l'IA dans ton travail CRM : analyse, production, QA, rédaction, automatisation. On te demandera un cas d'usage réel, avec le résultat.

-       Expertise du secteur assurance, banque, fintech, ou environnement SaaS B2C,

title: CRM Marketing Manager
description:
Headquarters: Armenia
URL: http://cxmdirect.com

Description

CRM Marketing Manager

Reporting to: CMO
Location: Fully Remote
Markets: 12

About the Role

We are looking for a CRM Marketing Manager to own CXM’s customer lifecycle marketing across 12 markets. You will use customer data, segmentation, automation, and personalised communications to improve activation, first-time deposits, retention, reactivation, and customer lifetime value.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build CRM journeys from the ground up, manage campaigns across multiple markets, and use performance data to continuously improve results.

Key Objectives

  • Build and launch at least 3 automated lifecycle journeys covering welcome/activation, retention, and reactivation within the first 6 months.
  • Improve the current 9% lead-to-FTD conversion rate through targeted CRM activation campaigns.
  • Support reducing churn to below 10% through structured retention and reactivation programmes.
  • Build and maintain localised CRM journeys across all 12 markets.
  • Maintain 99%+ deliverability and ensure all CRM activity meets applicable compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Lifecycle & CRM Strategy

  • Own customer journeys across onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, loyalty, VIP, churn prevention, and win-back.
  • Define triggers, audiences, journey logic, exclusions, frequency caps, and exit criteria.
  • Coordinate email and push communications to create a consistent customer experience.

Campaigns & Automation

  • Build, launch, and optimise automated CRM campaigns using platforms such as Mailgun, Braze, Klaviyo, or equivalent.
  • Create targeted campaigns based on customer behaviour, lifecycle stage, market, language, and product.
  • Manage promotional campaigns, newsletters, VIP communications, retention campaigns, and partner communications.
  • Develop and maintain reusable email templates and content blocks.

Segmentation & Personalisation

  • Build and maintain customer segments, consent lists, exclusions, and communication rules.
  • Configure personalised and dynamic content based on customer data.
  • Work with Product, Analytics, and IT to define and validate data and event requirements.
  • SQL knowledge is a strong advantage.

Localisation

  • Manage CRM communications across multiple languages and markets.
  • Coordinate translation, editing, and linguistic QA.
  • Ensure correct currencies, dates, links, variables, legal messaging, tone, and RTL requirements.
  • Maintain master journeys and localisation matrices across all markets.

Deliverability & Compliance

  • Monitor deliverability, bounces, spam complaints, suppression lists, and domain/IP reputation.
  • Maintain strong email hygiene and deliverability standards.
  • Run detailed pre-launch QA covering audiences, links, variables, tracking, content, sender details, and scheduling.
  • Ensure campaigns comply with consent, unsubscribe, data retention, and local regulatory requirements.

Analytics & Optimisation

  • Analyse CRM performance by market, language, segment, and customer lifecycle stage.
  • Measure conversion, retention, churn, revenue, and incremental uplift — not just opens and clicks.
  • Run A/B and holdout tests across offers, messaging, timing, frequency, channels, and journey structure.
  • Maintain a clear optimisation backlog and turn insights into measurable improvements.


Requirements
  • Proven experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, email marketing, or marketing automation.
  • Hands-on experience building automated customer journeys.
  • Strong understanding of segmentation, personalisation, triggers, and lifecycle strategy.
  • Experience managing CRM across multiple markets and languages.
  • Strong knowledge of email deliverability and campaign QA.
  • Experience with Mailgun, Braze, Klaviyo, or similar CRM platforms.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.
  • Comfortable working with technical and data teams.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Experience in FX, fintech, trading, igaming, or another regulated B2C environment is highly desirable.
  • Able to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Ideal Candidate Background

The strongest candidates are likely to be currently working as a:

  • CRM Manager / Lifecycle Marketing Manager
  • Email Marketing Manager
  • Marketing Automation Specialist
  • Retention Marketing Manager
  • CRM-focused Digital Marketing Manager

Experience with high-volume B2C customer journeys, FTD/conversion funnels, retention, reactivation, and regulated markets will be particularly valuable.



Benefits

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working with minimal meeting overhead.
  • Ownership of CRM across 12 international markets.
  • Genuine opportunity to build and improve the customer lifecycle function.
  • An established business with the resources and budget to execute ambitious CRM initiatives.
  • Freedom to test, learn, and implement new ideas.
  • Competitive, above-market compensation.
  • KPI-linked bonus connected directly to CRM and business performance.

Recruitment Process

Stage 1: HR interview — experience, motivation, and fit.
Stage 2: CMO interview — CRM expertise, strategy, and relevant experience.
Stage 3: CEO interview, where required.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cxm-direct-crm-marketing-manager

title: VP Pricing & Packaging
description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

  • Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure.

  • Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it.

  • Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing.

  • Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product.

  • The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement.

  • Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function.

  • A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench.

  • Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body.

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management.

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.

title: Confirmed Product Analyst - Demand
description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your mission
Our Data department is organised following Data Mesh principles, distributing data ownership to cross-functional and domain-specific teams that manage, own, and serve the data as a product.
The Data Demand team’s mission is to help BlaBlaCar grow as a global OTA through data, covering the full customer journey from brand and product discovery through marketing and landing pages, to search, booking, post-booking, and payment. As the team expands its scope from self-service towards decision intelligence, we want to strengthen our ability to proactively analyse member, marketplace, and product behaviours, and to influence the decisions that shape the product.
As a Data Analyst, you will join the Data Demand team to drive decision-making through data: framing the right questions with stakeholders, going deep into data to explain what is happening, sizing opportunities, interpreting experiments, and translating insights into actionable recommendations for Product and Marketing teams.
Your responsibilities
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Business stakeholders to understand their goals, frame analytical questions, and identify the decisions where data can have the highest impact.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other Data Analysts to improve the quality, usability, and coverage of our data products, and explore opportunities to turn advanced analytics or ML/AI initiatives into measurable business impact.
Lead end-to-end analyses on product and business topics such as marketplace dynamics, search-to-book performance, member behaviour, audience knowledge, or CRM and marketing impact.
Go beyond dashboards to investigate the “why” behind trends, anomalies, and performance changes, combining exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, and strong business context.
Build clear narratives from data: communicate findings, trade-offs, confidence levels, and recommendations in a way that helps stakeholders align and act.
Contribute to reusable business knowledge and context engineering by documenting insights, analytical frameworks, or business relationships, and play a governance role in aligning definitions, reducing gaps between teams, and improving data quality over time.
Leverage BlaBlaCar’s available GenAI tools to work more efficiently in day-to-day analysis and documentation, while applying strong critical thinking to challenge, validate, and contextualise the outputs before using them in decision-making.
Your qualifications
Master’s degree or equivalent: engineering school, business school, etc
At least 3 years of professional experience working as a Data Analyst
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience analysing large and complex datasets.
Good understanding of product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, experimentation, and performance monitoring.
Ability to structure ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, and translate business or product questions into robust analytical approaches.
Experience with data visualisation, with a strong sense of how to design clear, trustworthy, and decision-oriented outputs.
Solid communication skills: you can turn analysis into a compelling story, adapt your message to different audiences, and influence decisions with clarity and humility.
Comfort working with cross-functional teams and building strong stakeholder relationships.
Curiosity for product, growth, marketplaces, and member behaviour, with a pragmatic mindset focused on impact over perfect analysis.
Python or another analytical programming language, causal inference, or advanced experimentation knowledge is a plus.
Fluent in English 
If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!

4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
